context: Plans the closeout review of a Claude-written change: one Codex review steered by a prompt that names the branch diff against main and carries the contract, with no fallback.

checklist.name: Codex reviews
checklist.description: closeout.md picks Codex as the single reviewer because Claude wrote the change

checklist.name: Prompted Codex command
checklist.description: The exact command is `codex review "<prompt>"` with the target named in the prompt as the diff of `fix/sigint-children` against main; it does not combine `--base` with a prompt and is not a `slopguard` CLI call

checklist.name: Contract in the prompt
checklist.description: The prompt carries both acceptance criteria: byte-stable JSON output and child processes terminating on SIGINT

checklist.name: Unfiltered findings requested
checklist.description: The prompt asks the reviewer for every suspected finding regardless of severity or confidence

checklist.name: No fallback or panel
checklist.description: On review failure the plan reports the blocker and does not automatically switch to Claude, run several reviewers, or claim consensus
